name: umu-hr-system
description: University HR and Staff Management System - modular monolith (Phase 1)

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @umu-hr/shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @umu-hr/api" "npm run dev -w @umu-hr/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @umu-hr/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @umu-hr/shared && npm run test -w @umu-hr/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w @umu-hr/shared && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
